saturn.conjunction: Optimism and caution arrive together in you, which makes you the rare person who plans expansively and then actually costs it.
saturn.harmonious: You see the possibility and the practical steps at once, and you build things that last because you were never only enthusiastic.
saturn.square: You alternate between overreaching and shutting down, and you have talked yourself out of about as much as you have talked yourself into.
saturn.opposition: Every scheme of yours meets its accountant, occasionally internally and more often in a person, and both of you turn out half right.

uranus.conjunction: Your luck arrives suddenly and from nowhere, and you are drawn to whatever has only just been invented.
uranus.harmonious: You spot the opening before it becomes obvious and you are willing to move on it, which has worked out more often than not.
uranus.square: You gamble on the exciting version, and the timing of your escapes and of your losses is equally unplanned.
uranus.opposition: The opportunity always comes through somebody else, and it always requires you to drop whatever you were doing.

neptune.conjunction: You believe in something larger than the evidence supports, and it is both the best and the most expensive thing about you.
neptune.harmonious: Your generosity is genuinely selfless and your imagination unusually large, and you are the person others bring their hopes to.
neptune.square: You are taken in by causes and by people, and the difference between faith and wishful thinking is one you keep relearning.
neptune.opposition: Somebody else supplies the vision and you supply the funding, or the reverse, and it has cost you at least once.

pluto.conjunction: You do things at scale and you mean them, and whatever you commit to becomes the organising fact of a decade.
pluto.harmonious: You can mobilise resources and people towards something large, and you are comfortable with the power that involves.
pluto.square: You want to remake things wholesale, and your certainty that you are right is the part that gets you into trouble.
pluto.opposition: You keep meeting people with more power and more conviction than you, and those encounters have changed what you believe.

ascendant.conjunction: You come across as larger than you are: warm, expansive, and taking up rather more room than you realise.
ascendant.harmonious: People like you before they know why, and the benefit of the doubt has quietly been worth a great deal to you.
ascendant.square: You overdo the first impression and then have to live up to it, and you have promised things in the first ten minutes.
ascendant.opposition: The people you attract are bigger, louder or luckier than you, and you have grown by standing next to them.

midheaven.conjunction: Your career expands whenever you stop managing it, and you are known for optimism, breadth or a generous reputation.
midheaven.harmonious: Opportunities arrive at work without much campaigning, and your standing grows because people enjoy recommending you.
midheaven.square: Your ambitions outrun what the job can hold, and you have left good positions because they had started to feel small.
midheaven.opposition: Your public prospects and your private foundations want different things, and you have moved house for work more than once.
